remarks: MUST SEE!!! Spacious & beautifully appointed luxury condominium; move-in ready and nestled in the heart of Williamsville with highly rated schools and attractive finishes throughout. This sought-after and picturesque unit rests in a peaceful development with professionally designed landscaping and desirable amenities including a beautifully maintained pool. Featuring a charming & renovated kitchen with new wood cabinetry, and breakfast bar with gorgeous luxury vinyl floors that flow throughout the front hall to the elegant living room and dining area enhanced by a sliding glass door opening onto the balcony overlooking the scenic trees, perfect for sipping your morning coffee. Enjoy the generous living room featuring vaulted ceilings allowing an abundance of natural light, and two bright & roomy bedrooms with an updated bathroom & in-unit laundry for EASE OF LIVING! Additional updates include a new HWT (2026), newer Heil furnace, and new light fixtures throughout. Impeccably kept with timeless and open parking for convenience! Minutes away from Clearfield Library and Recreation Center, Billy Wilson Park, and the incredible Village of Williamsville with local shops & entertainment on Main Street with low taxes and great schools. Showings begin 9/22/2026. Open House Saturday 10/17/2026 from 11:00 am - 1:00 pm.
